description: A series of deep chalk-cut shafts containing the remains of young dogs, these shafts were bound by a linear ditch to the north. The fills of the shafts and the ditch date between the 2nd - 3rd CE, to the west a series of puts produced more material of a similar date. The RSRB sees fit to categorise the site as a 'shrine', but provides little justification, we are left to assume that it is because of the 'strangeness' of the site.
